# Manchester United Secures Ugarte in Major Summer Transfer

Manchester United has successfully completed the acquisition of Manuel Ugarte from Paris Saint-Germain, marking a significant reinforcement of their midfield. The Uruguayan international, aged 23, arrives at Old Trafford on a five-year agreement with an additional optional year, representing an investment of €50 million with potential bonuses reaching €10 million.

This signing represents manager Erik ten Hag's fifth substantial addition during the current transfer window, as the club continues its ambitious rebuilding project. Ugarte joins existing squad member Casemiro in the number 6 position, providing the manager with quality depth in defensive midfield roles.

The young South American expressed his enthusiasm about joining such a prestigious institution, emphasizing his determination to contribute to the club's return to championship-winning status. In his statement, Ugarte highlighted his commitment to the project outlined by the club's leadership and his eagerness to play before the passionate Manchester United supporters at their historic stadium.

United's sporting director Dan Ashworth confirmed that securing Ugarte had been among the club's primary objectives for the summer transfer campaign. This acquisition demonstrates the organization's continued commitment to strengthening their squad and establishing themselves among Europe's elite clubs once again.
